notes: Check 1: no Clarity election list for TX/Johnson (elections.json 404). Check 2 failed: the seed elections page and the county homepage (www.johnsoncountytx.org) return HTTP 403 to every request (bot protection), which was not worked around. One web search for the county's results page returned only unrelated pages (Johnson County, Kansas) and general sources, so no vendor site was found. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-D): no election changed. Check 3 now available: wayback-data has election-night captures of www.johnsoncountytx.org/departments/elections-office for 2024 general only (21:04 to 02:15 CST); they show navigation links 'General Election Results November 5th' (/departments/elections-office/election-results/general-election-results-november-5th) and a 'Ballot Counting Room Livestream', but no results content and no capture of the results subpage; no captures for the 2026 primary or runoff. County site still HTTP 403 to the fetch module (including /home/showpublisheddocument/19901/... and /17586/... found by search); not worked around. Two web searches (Cleburne/Johnson County results) found only Kansas, Missouri and Wyoming pages. Sweep pending. Targeted pass 4 2026-10-02 (targeted4-E): no election changed. Tried: wayback-data again (only the 2024 general election-night captures of the elections-office page; their links are navigation pages and two non-results documents, no results documents, no vendor or results host; no phase1/targeted/ or sweep folder for Johnson, sweep pending); five web searches for other public hosts (county results PDFs, Cleburne Times-Review, city or party reposts, newtools.cira.state.tx.us copies) found only Kansas, Kentucky, Wyoming and other Texas counties' files, plus county-site links /home/showpublisheddocument/19591/639056427144300000, /19901/639088362442270000 and /17586/638671920971370000, which stay on the 403 host (not fetched again; their version numbers decode to 2026-02-02, 2026-03-11 and 2024-11-14, none on an election night). A newtools page-3107 'ELECTION DAY VOTES' precinct file that search tied to Johnson was fetched and is another county (30,571 registered voters, precincts 1 to 33). Check 4: Cleburne Times-Review archive search for Nov 5 to 7 2024 and Mar 3 to 5 2026 found only total-vote stories (for example 'Burleson passes liquor proposition': 'The measure saw 13,889 votes for and 6,752 against.'), no per-precinct tables. County site not retried and not worked around. About 6 fetches.
